name: D. Junk Removal Crew, LLC
h1: We haul it off. *We clean up everything.*
lead: Removal of any unwanted junk, hauled to the dump, across northern Ohio from Findlay to Lorain, Lucas, Cuyahoga and Erie counties.
services: Couches, mattresses, dressers and anything else you're done with.
Fridges, washers, dryers and water heaters hauled away.
We load it, haul it and take care of the dump run.
When the junk is gone, the space gets cleaned up too.
about: D. Junk Removal Crew removes any unwanted junk and hauls it away to the dump, then cleans up everything.
They're based in Findlay and work across northern Ohio counties.
